title: BDCF GJBIBJCA BJBJ BGFBG CDFFBB
about: An album built around memories, experiences, and moments from 4-H State Arts-In, capturing the people, places, traditions, and behind-the-scenes experiences that made those years memorable.
body: BDCF GJBIBJCA BJBJ BGFBG CDFFBB looks back at State Arts-In through the moments and experiences that stood out along the way.
Each song focuses on a different memory, from the people and friendships to the unusual traditions, backstage moments, and experiences that became part of the story.
Together, the tracks preserve pieces of State Arts-In that might otherwise exist only as memories, turning them into a record of what those years were like.
The album is less about telling one continuous story and more about collecting the individual moments that made State Arts-In what it was.
